messages:
sasha (solutions): Hey team - customer asks for evidence on audit logging, KMS rotation, and a clear RBAC change timeline. Can we pull together short answers and an artifact they can attach?
elaine (sec): I can draft a one-pager. Quick clarifying q: do they need per-request signed logs or just immutable append-only logs with integrity proofs?
sasha (solutions): They mentioned 'log-proof' and chain-of-trust. Prefer per-request verifiability but would accept verifiable append-only if we can show tamper detection.
tom (infra): We currently ship append-only audit logs to GCS with object versioning + signed manifests. For per-request proofs we'd need to add signed statements at ingestion. Example we could add an HMAC envelope: `HMAC(secret_rotation_key, <log_entry_json>)`.
raj (eng-sre): For incident timelines we already store immutable chunks and keep an index in BigTable. Retention is 365d by default; can export to customer's S3 for longer retention.
elaine (sec): For KMS rotation: key material is in customer-managed KMS (when enabled). Rotation policy: automatic yearly rotation or on-demand via support. We can provide a rotation log showing key-id, rotate_ts, and RA (requesting admin).
sasha (solutions): Can we attach a sample rotation audit? The customer needs a csv with key-id, previous-key-fingerprint, rotated_at, owner, and an audit hash.
tom (infra): I can export that. Quick sample from staging (redacted):
```
key-id,prev-fp,rotated_at,owner
kms-prod-1,aa11bb22,2026-10-01T05:12:23Z,ops@redwood
```
Hash: sha256 of the csv = `f3b9...`
sec-bot: Automation run: rotation-audit-export succeeded for project=redwood-prod at 2026-10-01T05:20:01Z. Artifact: gs://redwood-audit/rotation-2026-10-01.csv (access: restricted).
elaine (sec): RBAC changes: we keep an RBAC changelog tied to our IaC. Every policy change goes through PR and audit trail in Git. For enterprise packs we can provide a filtered export showing policy-id, change_ts, author, and diff.
sasha (solutions): Customer asked how we prove 'who changed what' for RBAC. Is the git commit + signed merge sufficient?
raj (eng-sre): We sign our releases with CI's GPG key and record merge approvals in GH. For extra assurance we can include the commit signature and the GitHub audit entry showing the approving user.
tom (infra): For logs integrity, we also compute per-day Merkle root of the day's entries and sign the root with a rotation key. We can provide the Merkle root and leaf proofs for a sample entry.
elaine (sec): Action items: 1) Sasha - gather customer scoping (what retention + proof level). 2) Tom - export key rotation csv & merkle proof sample. 3) Raj - export RBAC change history sample and CI signatures. 4) Me - assemble one-pager and an FAQ.
sasha (solutions): I'll confirm retention needs in the call we have Wed 15:00 PT. If they want per-request proofs we'll raise an SOW.
raj (eng-sre): Note on incident response: if an incident occurs we preserve full raw audit logs and produce a stamped evidence bundle. That process is in /docs/incident-response/audit-evidence.md (internal).
tom (infra): Practical snippet for merkle root calc we used in PoC:
```
# python pseudocode
leaves = [sha256(json_line) for json_line in day_log]
root = merkle_root(leaves)
signature = KMS.sign(current_signing_key, root)
```
We can supply a signed root + leaf proof for one sample request.
elaine (sec): Compliance note: for customers requiring FIPS/HSM backed keys we can route to their HSM via Private deployment or our KMS integration with customer-managed keys. Include KMS provider and region in the artifacts.
sasha (solutions): Perfect. Any blockers to getting these artifacts by Tue EOD?
tom (infra): No blocker. I'll drop export links into this thread when done.
raj (eng-sre): I can prepare RBAC export and attach signatures. ETA Tue 18:00 PT.
elaine (sec): I'll assemble the one-pager Tue night.
sasha (solutions): Thanks all. I'll prep the customer call agenda and share the doc before the call.
sec-bot: Reminder: scheduled security review call with ACME Inc. added to calendar 2026-10-02T15:00:00-07:00. Meeting notes template: /templates/sec-review.md
sasha (solutions): Acked, will send pre-read.
file_description: Customer security questionnaire follow-up thread about audit logging proofs, KMS rotation export, RBAC changelogs, and incident evidence. Includes small code snippets and automation bot messages.
